content: Build a baseline for a tabular Kaggle-style competition. The target is churn, the metric is AUC, and I need a submission CSV.
I will start a notebook from scratch, load train.csv and test.csv, inspect every column with the model, and write custom preprocessing helpers.
I am pasting the full 1,200-line data dictionary into context so I can remember every field while coding.
I am creating split_train_valid(), fill_missing_values(), encode_categoricals(), auc_score(), and write_submission_csv() in the notebook.

AIDevObserver note: this looks like a solved competition-baseline route. The primitive database already has dataset.inspect_schema, table.fill_missing_values, table.encode_categoricals, table.train_valid_split_seeded, metric.compute_auc, model.train_lightgbm, and submission.write_csv.
I normalized the session as KaggleBaselineRequest to SubmissionArtifact and found template tabular_competition_baseline.
CandidateBundle: inspect, split, impute, encode, train, evaluate, submit. The split must be seeded and the submission gate must verify row count and id column alignment.
Compiler applies only registered field remixes for schema aliases, rejects target leakage features, and blocks submission until the AUC metric gate and submission-format gate pass.
Runtime stores the feature table, model, eval report, and submission CSV as ArtifactRefs and emits JSONL ledger events with runtime planner calls set to zero.
Promotion remains candidate-only: this is synthetic_from_public_project shape evidence, not registry truth.
